CLOSED against merged work. Merge SHAs (BOTH reference this ticket):
- 77fc1b9961c65f2985c42f485c54d5ad20ff885e — "bc5d-ffba-006b-4241: add agentic in-CI DC probe"
- fafe25e0d1abfbade07d22c51f599672e7ac1707 — "Pin DC rich-text probe to direct-Anthropic model"
Both are ancestors of origin/main (ae4f6c1a07a9). Closed with --ref fafe25e0d1abfbade07d22c51f599672e7ac1707: the LATER of the two (77fc1b99 is its ancestor), so the verified tree carries both commits' final content; a pinned immutable SHA, never a moving ref.

file_impact: the union across BOTH commits is {tests/external/live_jira_dc/test_dc_richtext_agentic_probe.py, .github/workflows/jira-dc-richtext-probe.yml, tests/unit/test_workflow_names.py} — fafe25e0 touched only the workflow yml, which 77fc1b99 already introduced. That union is EXACTLY the file_impact already recorded, so no set-file-impact call was made (a replace would have been a no-op at best and an orphaning hazard at worst).

Per-AC evidence:
AC1 (exists, lint/format clean, collects+skips with opt-in unset): ruff check and ruff format --check clean on the module; pytest --collect-only collects 1 test with REBAR_DC_RICHTEXT_PROBE unset (no live DC needed); a plain run reports SKIPPED with reason "opt-in agentic probe: set REBAR_DC_RICHTEXT_PROBE=1".
AC2 (reuses existing fixtures): the test signature takes bound_dc_issue, dc_store_copy_repo, dc_transport, dc_request — all defined in tests/external/live_jira_dc/_dc_fixtures.py (L309/L182/L138) and conftest.py (L792); no bound-store bootstrap is re-ported.
AC3 (run_python + jira_rest, registered RichTextRca, assert-only-a-finding): _make_tools returns both tools over a PERSISTENT namespace built by _build_namespace (transport, compute_update_fields, diff_canonical_fields, WikiTextCodec, cutover_clients, dc, rebar); _register_contract_once calls rebar.llm.contracts.register_contract (verified present in the installed package); RunRequest passes mode="structured", output_schema=CONTRACT_NAME, execution_mode="agentic", extra_tools=[run_python, jira_rest]. The only assertion is "assert result is not None" — it cannot fail merely because the bug still reproduces.
AC4 (workflow shape): "on: workflow_dispatch: {}" only (no push/PR/schedule); DC image digest-pinned via tests/external/live_jira_dc/Dockerfile FROM addono/jira-software-standalone@sha256:04326628...; "uv sync --locked --extra dev --extra jira-datacenter" installs BOTH extras; a dedicated "Require an LLM API key secret" step exits 1 with ::error:: when ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is empty (loud fail); REBAR_MCP_READONLY: "1" is set on the run step; upload-artifact@v4 with "if: always()" uploads jira-dc-richtext-probe (rca.json + evidence.json).
AC5 [non-codebase] (dispatched run on main): GitHub Actions run https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/33129851229 — workflow_dispatch, branch main, conclusion success. Its jira-dc-richtext-probe artifact was downloaded and inspected: rca.json carries every RichTextRca contract field (mechanism, failing_layer=differ, wire_computed_nonempty, raw_stored_after_write, reemit_cause, recommended_fix_site, attribution_hint, confidence=high) with 10 experiments citing 20 evidence ids, and evidence.json holds 51 entries spanning both tool kinds (run_python, jira_rest). LIVENESS ANCHOR: the cited ev-NNNN ids resolve into evidence.json rather than being a model summary, and the earlier dispatch 33123246464 FAILED on the missing model pin — the very failure fafe25e0 fixed — so a success here is not the trivially-reachable state.

The description edit (adding the [non-codebase] tag + provenance line to AC5) staled the prior plan-review attestation, so review-plan was re-run at --ref fafe25e0...: verdict PASS, 0 blocking, 3 advisory (P6 compound-criterion wording; T7 suggests a README note for the new probe; both non-blocking). Completion-verifier attestation verified: "rebar verify-signature bc5d-ffba-006b-4241 --kind completion-verifier" -> certified. No force override was used at any point.
